review_method: All 14 QA13 pages directly inspected. QA14 changed pages 9, 10, 13 directly reinspected. Final QA15 changed only pages 9 and 10, directly reinspected; all other page-image hashes match inspected QA14 pages.

page_notes.1: Title, abstract, physics motivation and study scope read; no detector-performance overclaim.
page_notes.2: Target, zero-threshold definition, stored geometry and Figure 1 read; dimensions and beam-frame caveat clear.
page_notes.3: Population provenance and Figure 2 architecture read; every stage has a readable physical role.
page_notes.4: Response, activity factorization, energy cap and first flow target read; equations and units legible.
page_notes.5: Flow solver, layer budgets, count, graph message and hit selection read; independence and placement limits clear.
page_notes.6: Channel-energy flow, decoder closure, teacher forcing and joint loss read; no incident-energy conservation claim.
page_notes.7: Training selection, gap/segment/group definitions, bound and paired-classifier control read; no causal attribution.
page_notes.8: Primary results table and energy/longitudinal results read; separate populations and intervals explicit.
page_notes.9: Energy and illustrative support figures read; toy graph clearly marked, contiguous-segment result legible.
page_notes.10: Hit-count distance, classifier, numerical checks and diagnostic mechanisms read; paragraph now starts coherently.
page_notes.11: Threshold, time, geometry, timing, reconstruction limitations and conclusion read; fit and hierarchy clear.
page_notes.12: Acknowledgment, AI disclosure, checkpoint hashes and calibration table read; no affiliation label.
page_notes.13: Energy-bin/classifier tables and pair-split arithmetic read; 70% per row and 4,200 expected rows distinct.
page_notes.14: All 25 bibliography entries visible and legible; no clipping or unresolved citations.

scientific_scope: Visual and textual review, not physics validation.
